title: sandboxed same-host iframe (allow-scripts only, opaque origin) calls get

unsafe.definition: an assertion to the opaque-origin frame, e.g. by treating it as https://rp-a.test

note: HTML sandbox without allow-same-origin gives an opaque origin; L3 §5.1.4.1: opaque callerOrigin -> NotAllowedError (an RP ID cannot be derived). UNCERTAIN: an engine may report SecurityError (no valid effective domain) instead.
